claims.claim_text: Before road-testing a trained CNN, the networks performance is first evaluated in simulation.
claims.normalized_text: Evaluate trained CNN performance in simulation before road-testing.

claims.claim_text: The simulator takes pre-recorded videos from a forward-facing on-board camera on a human-driven data-collection vehicle and generates images that approximate what would appear if the CNN were steering the vehicle.
claims.normalized_text: Simulator uses pre-recorded videos from human-driven vehicle to generate images approximating CNN steering.

claims.claim_text: These test videos are time-synchronized with recorded steering commands generated by the human driver.
claims.normalized_text: Test videos are time-synchronized with human driver steering commands.
